reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the cited text supports it: §5 (p0023) provides only a revenue share of amounts actually generated, with no minimum, penalty, or pre-estimated sum payable by the Customer.

The sole termination-related payment (p0016) gives Kubient 'all fees generated during the termination period' — revenue actually earned during the 90-day notice period, not a lump-sum early-termination fee or remaining-term payout, so it is not a Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalty under the rule.
No redline or counterparty comment is expected or provided for a compliant finding; the rendered paragraphs are unchanged and no deterministic check failures were reported.
Rationale is accurate and directionally correct (rule applies only where Customer pays); retaining as internal evaluation evidence is appropriate.
